_comment: DOCUMENTATION MIRROR ONLY. The runtime canonical TTU faculties/majors live in src/config/ttu.ts (TypeScript module bundled with the app). This file is a human-readable snapshot for reference and is NOT loaded by the application. If the two ever drift, the TS module wins at runtime. To re-validate this file against the TS module, run `pnpm data:validate` (see scripts/validate-ttu-data.ts).
name: جامعة الطفيلة التقنية
internalAppIdNote: "ttu" is the internal app ID; not a claim of an official university ID.
